text:
maria_docs: FYI PR #6499 updates the 'on-prem quickstart' with a CLI example that included an example `--api-token` value. Legal flagged it during review as a possible real token. Can we triage?

tony_devx: Oops, I used a long hex string as a placeholder. It looks realistic. Should replace with `<REDACTED_TOKEN>` or an env var.

security_anna: Please remove any token-like literals. Even fake tokens should be non-runnable and clearly marked. Also request a brief note reminding readers to rotate credentials after import.

compliance_jr: Also need a compliance approval because the doc references 'customer migration checklist' which links to an internal doc. That internal link must be removed or gated.

maria_docs: I'll swap token literal to `--api-token=$RESPONSE_API_TOKEN` and change link to an external KB with generic steps.

docs-ci: Preview: <https://deploy-preview-6499--docs.redwood.com> -> lint: fail: docs/onprem/quickstart.md line 52: token-placeholder-detected.

maria_docs: Reworked snippet and pushed `chore(docs): redact token + replace internal link` -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/ghi789

docs-ci: Re-run checks: lint: pass, build: pass, link-checker: warning -> external link redirects to partner site. Preview available.

infra_paul: Ops note: the quickstart previously included a `curl` that POSTs config to `localhost:8080`. Now it references `kms:///secrets/` which is fine, but add a footnote for on-prem: "use local HSM or vault".

maria_docs: Added footnote and brief HSM example.

security_anna: Reviewing updated text: LGTM. Please add one line to changelog: "Redacted example API token and removed internal link."

compliance_jr: I reviewed the wording and external link. Approve pending changelog.

maria_docs: Added changelog entry under docs/CHANGELOG.md.

deploy_bot: Merge window: low-traffic slot tonight 21:45 PT. Would you like me to auto-merge at that time if checks remain green?

maria_docs: Yes please hold and auto-merge at 21:45 PT. I'll be online to monitor canary.

infra_paul: I'll run the canary and watch for link regressions and CDN invalidation.

docs-ci: All checks currently passing.

maria_docs: Thanks all. Noted security + compliance approvals. Scheduling merge. Will post in #release-war-room 30m before.

maria_docs: (later) Merge done at 21:46 PT, canary run ok, CDN purged.

deploy_bot: Post-merge audit: no sensitive artifacts found in commit history. Thread closed.

maria_docs: Closing loop. Great fast turnaround — thanks everyone.
